claims.claim: The speaker believes Nintendo is a high-return secular growth juggernaut with an inevitable future of getting bigger and more profitable.
claims.quote: I think Nintendo is what we've long said it was inevitable to use Buffett-Parlon, the high return secular broke juggernaut, that will continually, just keep getting bigger and better, more profitable with time.

claims.claim: The speaker states that at the current valuation, there are no material risks left regarding the thesis.
claims.quote: I don't think at this valuation, there is any material risks left with respect to the thesis.

claims.claim: The speaker describes Nintendo as an Apple-like ecosystem reinforced by Disney-like IP content, creating a radically improved and resilient business.
claims.quote: Basically, Nintendo has created an Apple-like ecosystem that has been reinforced, ironically enough, by a very Disney-like IP content, flywheel. And the sum total of these changes has resulted in a radically improved, more economically resilient revenue and cash flow, completely de-sipifying at earnings power.

claims.claim: The speaker asserts that the stock is dirt cheap and there will be explosive growth in revenue and profit.
claims.quote: But the bottom line is the stock is dirt cheap. We have four to five years at least, I think, a truly explosive growth in both revenue and profit. This is not uncertain. This is, in fact, highly certain.
